item.text:
**8B.6**

**Assessment**
Sharif did convert several declarations into visible implementation in 2024, especially on welfare delivery, power theft, counterterrorism, and some corrective bureaucratic actions. But the record also shows that many reforms remained incomplete, centrally managed, or dependent on coercive controls rather than durable institutional execution. So this is a qualified positive, not a clean or comprehensive one.

**Accepted claims**
- **Technocratic finance staffing** | *Reuters via ThePrint* | **2024-03-11** | https://theprint.in/world/pakistan-pm-to-choose-banker-aurangzeb-as-finance-minister-sources-say/1996592/ | Sharif chose Muhammad Aurangzeb, a career banker, for finance instead of a party loyalist. This is a concrete staffing move that supports implementation capacity rather than slogan politics. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **BISP digital wallets** | *APP* | **2024-03-18** | https://www.app.com.pk/national/pm-shehbaz-directs-full-digitalization-of-social-welfare-payments-under-bisp/ | Sharif ordered BISP payments onto digital wallets to reduce leakage, delays, and discretion. That is direct implementation, not rhetorical commitment. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.3`
- **Education emergency with targets** | *Radio Pakistan* | **2024-05-08** | https://www.radio.gov.pk/08-05-2024/pm-declares-education-emergency-to-enroll-26-million-out-of-school-children | He set a numeric enrollment target, said he would personally supervise the program, and linked it to provincial coordination and incentives. This is observable program execution language, not a pure slogan. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`
- **Anti-power-theft machinery** | *Radio Pakistan* | **2024-05-28** | https://www.radio.gov.pk/28-05-2024/shehbaz-sharif-directs-to-minimize-load-shedding | Sharif ordered monthly reviews, provincial and law-enforcement support, task forces, and expert hiring for DISCO privatization. This is concrete administrative follow-through. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.4`
- **National counterterrorism campaign** | *Radio Pakistan* | **2024-06-22** | https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism | He launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and explicit resource support for the armed forces. This shows state reach being mobilized for a declared security goal. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.5`
- **FBR corrective action** | *Dawn* | **2024-05-08** | https://www.dawn.com/news/1832117 | After an internal report found the track-and-trace system ineffective, Sharif ordered action against responsible officials. That is a direct example of converting diagnosis into action. | IDs: `8B.6`, `7B.10`, `8B.5`
- **Power tariff renegotiation** | *Reuters via Dawn* | **2024-10-10** | https://www.dawn.com/news/amp/1864298 | The government renegotiated costly power contracts to lower tariffs and save about Rs60 billion a year. That is a tangible policy change, not just rhetoric. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.3`, `8B.4`
- **Inquiry commission on ISI intimidation allegations** | *Reuters via Al Jazeera* | **2024-03-28** | https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/3/28/pakistan-to-investigate-armys-meddling-in-judiciary-law-minister-says | After judges alleged ISI intimidation, the government said it would form an inquiry commission. This is limited but real follow-through on a politically sensitive abuse claim. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`, `8B.4`

- **Old-guard cabinet composition** | *Dawn* | **2024-03-01** | https://www.dawn.com/news/1821157 | The cabinet still leaned heavily on established political figures, which weakens the claim that declarations were fully converted into a new execution team. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **Family influence over appointments** | *Dawn* | **2024-02-19** | https://www.dawn.com/news/1815365/nawaz-busy-selecting-cabinet-as-khawaja-asif-sees-ppp-n-govt | Dawn reported Nawaz Sharif was heavily involved behind the scenes in cabinet selection. This cuts against a clean, program-driven implementation model. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`
- **Personalized control over ECNEC** | *Dawn* | **2024-06-15** | https://www.dawn.com/news/1839967 | Sharif kept direct control over ECNEC rather than fully delegating to the technocrat finance minister. That shows strong central control, but also incomplete institutionalization. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.4`, `8B.5`
- **Implementation still incomplete by year-end** | *IMF* | **2024-10-10** | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/10/10/pakistan-2024-article-iv-consultation-and-request-for-an-extended-arrangement-under-the-556152 | The IMF still described weak governance, a narrow tax base, very low investment, and insufficient health and education spending. That is strong evidence that major declarations had not yet fully translated into durable results. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`
- **Macro improvement, but poverty still rising** | *World Bank* | **2024-10-10** | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/10/09/-pakistan-reform-implementation-remains-critical-for-continued-economic-recovery-and-poverty-reduction-says-world-bank | Growth recovered and conditions stabilized, but poverty still rose and reforms were still needed. This supports partial implementation, not complete delivery. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.2`, `8B.3`
- **Media and scrutiny suppression** | *Human Rights Watch* | **2024-01-11** | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/pakistan-widening-crackdown-dissent | HRW said the government clamped down on dissenting media, the opposition, and NGOs, creating self-censorship and fear. That suggests state reach was also used for control, not just for program execution. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`, `8B.3`
- **X block around election period** | *Reuters via Investing.com* | **2024-04-17** | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/social-media-platform-x-blocked-in-pakistan-over-national-security-ministry-says-3382313 | The state confirmed blocking X on national-security grounds. This is observable state reach, but it is better evidence of information control than of clean program implementation. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`, `8B.3`
- **Judicial independence weakened** | *The Guardian* | **2024-10-21** | https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps | Critics said the 26th Amendment weakened judicial independence amid intimidation allegations. That undercuts the idea of durable institutional follow-through. | IDs: `8B.6`, `8B.5`, `8B.3`

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence of concrete implementation in a few flagship areas, but not a broad, cross-government record showing routine translation of all major declarations into durable outcomes.
- The weakest link is long-run institutionalization: many actions were top-down directives, ad hoc enforcement, or reactive probes, while IMF and World Bank still described the reform agenda as incomplete by late 2024.
